resources.string: Lets Pen Pad write your handwriting into the text field you were using in any app, lets pen shortcuts press Back, taps a frozen app you open from Pad Launch in Boox's Apps screen (which unfreezes it), notices pen-button taps on any screen (only that a tap happened, never where), and records which hardware keys (like the pen button) reach the system. It only reads or changes the text field you write into, keeps nothing, and passes every key on.
